name: MORSE-500
intro: MORSE-500是一个可程序控制的视频多模态推理压力测试，含500个内嵌问题的视频实例，覆盖抽象、数学、物理、规划、空间和时间六类推理。所有视频均通过确定性Python脚本生成，脚本可按实体数量、推理深度、干扰密度、时间动态和视觉复杂度扩展难度，并可在物理任务中纳入真实场景或视频生成模型素材；自动技术验证与作者人类评审共同保证可复现质量。
org: University of Maryland, Google, Cornell University
build_method: 程序化生成, 自动与人类质检
eval_feature: 六类推理, 可扩展难度, 内嵌问题
build_method_en: Programmatic Generation, Automated and Human Validation
eval_feature_en: Six reasoning categories, scalable difficulty, embedded questions
intro_en: MORSE-500 is a programmatically controllable video reasoning stress test with 500 question-embedded instances spanning abstract, mathematical, physical, planning, spatial, and temporal reasoning. Every video is generated through deterministic Python scripts that scale entity count, reasoning depth, distractor density, temporal dynamics, and visual complexity while incorporating real-world scenarios or video-generation material for suitable physics tasks; automated technical checks and author review enforce reproducible quality.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2506.05523 Sections 2-3 and Appendix A plus the released arXiv source. The diagram preserves the six-category cognitive taxonomy, benchmark and real/generated physics-source adaptation, domain-expert prototype stage, the all-videos-through-deterministic-Python-scripts contract and exact implementation libraries, five controlled complexity dimensions, embedded questions, automated 512p/codec/content/label checks, author review criteria and two-to-three-iteration refinement, exact 64/84/64/100/108/80 distribution, 3.1-hour total, native-video versus 2-FPS/32-frame/512-pixel inference, the fixed prompt, Qwen2.5-72B-AWQ answer extraction, and string-match accuracy.
